summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727 KB obfuscated payload
details: @onereach/cb-schema-translator declares its purpose as a CB schema to HTML translator, but its package.json preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a single-line 727,680-byte file whose contents are obfuscated with a rotating string-array dispatcher (`WV8StW` shift loop) and contain no readable strings. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated in the obfuscator.io hex-identifier style (`_0x488df8`, `_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync,...)`), wrapping the fs/https/execFileSync calls through a string-dispatch object. The Bun runtime and a `math_init` helper are unrelated to a schema-to-HTML converter, and executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime causes the actual behavior to bypass Node-based inspection. `npm install` of this package therefore runs opaque author-controlled code on the installer's machine via a runtime the installer did not previously have.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
